sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The expedition configuration allows 6 to 96 players and a six-hour instance.
The gatekeeper replaces the normal named population with fabled bosses whose lockouts have not been earned.
Each named completion records a five-day lockout. The finale includes the fabled awakened dragon.

notes: Approval E292. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
